svg.title: AWS Ktor Module Architecture
svg.desc: Architecture of bluetape4k AWS Ktor integration showing Ktor application entrypoints, shared defaults, client signing, server lifecycle plugins, and runtime service boundaries.
svg.text: Ktor 3 client and server integrations share AWS defaults while preserving app ownership of credentials, clients, and lifecycle scope.
SHARED DEFAULTS AND CLIENT DATA PATH
used when local config omits them
plugins inherit defaults only when local config is absent
Reader contract: aws-ktor supplies integration boundaries, not an application framework. Applications own credentials, app-scoped clients, route design, service dependencies, and lifecycle policy.
